# Jordan-certificate witnesses for Gal(f_p/Q) = S_p,  f_p = x(x-1)...(x-p+1)+1.
# Rows 'p q l degs': q is the least prime for which f_p mod q is squarefree,
# its factor-degree multiset 'degs' isolates a cycle of PRIME length l with
# 3 <= l <= p-3 coprime to every other degree, and sgn(Frob_q) = -1.
# Then Jordan (1873) gives A_p <= Gal, and the odd sign gives S_p.
# CFSG-free: no Guralnick, no Stickelberger, no reciprocity.
